bullets: Linkup Research Releases SPARSEUP: A 149M-Parameter Open-Source Sparse Embedding Model
PrismML Releases Ternary Bonsai 2 27B: A 5.9 GB Apache 2.0 Model Retaining 98.2% of Qwen3.8 27B Performance
Linkup Research has released SPARSEUP, an open-source sparse embedding model built on a 149M-parameter ModernBERT backbone.
